description: Paired prequential study of global-additive versus support-conditioned hierarchical whole-body kinematics learning.

rules.name: hks_infer_terminal_points_from_opaque_topology
rules.comment: Infer distal kinematic points from graph topology alone. The mechanical boundary supplies parent relations, never anatomical labels or a privileged endpoint list.

rules.name: hks_mint_global_action_point_model
rules.comment: Mint one name-free endpoint displacement model for each opaque action and graph-inferred terminal point.

rules.name: hks_mint_support_conditioned_action_point_model
rules.comment: Mint the hierarchical support-conditioned alternative over the same action and terminal-point inventory.

rules.name: hks_initialize_phase_model_from_global_prior
rules.comment: Initialize each support sheet from the learned global action-point relation with morphology-derived prior strength.

rules.name: hks_mint_observed_synergy_point_residual_model
rules.comment: Only a causally probed actuator pair receives an endpoint interaction model; the graph does not materialize the combinatorial pair space in advance.

rules.name: hks_mint_primitive_kinematic_arbitration_context
rules.comment: Mint one approach-selection context per terminal point, support regime and composition class. No action semantics enter it.

rules.name: hks_mint_compound_kinematic_arbitration_context
rules.comment: Mint one approach-selection context per terminal point, support regime and composition class. No action semantics enter it.

rules.name: hks_curiosity_reprobes_uncertain_kinematic_interaction
rules.comment: Before locomotion, re-sample each observed interaction until it has one receipt per sensed support channel, prioritizing the largest unresolved endpoint residual. The evidence target and pulse horizon are body-derived.

rules.name: hks_score_reach_basis_affordances
rules.comment: Materialize each eligible learned consequence once so subsequent graph searches compose compact stored intermediates.

rules.name: hks_derive_reachable_inverse_kinematic_goal
rules.comment: Choose a non-support endpoint from learned projection. The curriculum may request an experienced consequence, an off-manifold direction, or the composition of two distinct learned affordances. All remain graph-derived without anatomical labels, analytic inverse kinematics or host-side distance control.

rules.name: hks_analysis_by_synthesis_selects_inverse_reach
rules.comment: Invert learned forward endpoint models by comparing the predicted residual after every eligible primitive and causally verified compound. Selection remains over opaque actuator tokens.

rules.name: hks_close_inverse_reach_from_endpoint_receipt
rules.comment: Accumulate only the selected terminal point's measured body-relative motion. Success and exhaustion are graph verdicts over the receipt, never simulator-side IK or distance control.

rules.name: hks_record_reach_candidate_outcome_frontier
rules.comment: Retain a receipt-backed negative outcome for the current goal so analysis by synthesis explores another learned candidate before revisiting the worsened command.

rules.name: hks_bind_receipt_to_exact_arbitration_context
rules.comment: Materialize the exact point/support/composition context once so later reliability updates wake only their local receipts.

rules.name: hks_measure_paired_prequential_kinematic_error
rules.comment: Score both approaches before either receives this exact receipt. Simulator geometry is never used as a model or selector.

rules.name: hks_update_global_model_from_single_action_receipt
rules.comment: Only isolated action receipts identify primitive endpoint effects. Compound receipts remain held-out composition tests.

rules.name: hks_update_support-conditioned_model_from_single_action_receipt
rules.comment: Only isolated action receipts identify primitive endpoint effects. Compound receipts remain held-out composition tests.

rules.name: hks_update_global_momentum_gain
rules.comment: Learn momentum-conditioned endpoint gain only from reach receipts; calibration remains unaffected.

rules.name: hks_update_phase_momentum_gain
rules.comment: Learn momentum-conditioned endpoint gain only from reach receipts; calibration remains unaffected.

rules.name: hks_update_synergy_endpoint_interaction_residual
rules.comment: Learn only the endpoint residual left after the support-conditioned additive prediction. This preserves reusable primitive structure while representing measured non-additivity.

rules.name: hks_prequentially_arbitrate_kinematic_approach
rules.comment: Choose the approach with the best prior track record in this point/support/composition context, score that choice, then learn from the new receipt. Unseen contexts conservatively use global.
